diagnostic.scope: Interpretation aid only. A clean noTemporal return with stable coefficients is consistent with a history-path cause, but does not identify its exact pass. Nonzero noTemporal return refutes a solely temporal explanation. Original strict gates remain failed wherever pixels differ.

limits: No launch,wind,time,UTC,camera,source,mass or smoke-model edits. Caller supplies the same paused event and pose.
P is measured and checked identical, never overridden; a legitimate safety-budget change fails the fixedP scenario instead of being hidden.
The API-reset off→off deliberately repeats the exact history-reset side effect without changingGI.
Disabling temporal+glintAA changes only the second block; compare on/off within that block, not absolute AA-on vsAA-off images. MSAA/SMAA/bloom/air remain active and may still contribute rounding.
Probe bits attest raw published SH, not private base targets or whole-renderer state. HDR range extrema/counts are not sample-level image equality.
All PNGs come from explicit lens render and immediate export; no discarded-buffer paused toDataURL evidence.
Strict0pixel assertions are retained; observations are not a tolerance or a claim that visible GI/source photometry is absolutely calibrated.

bloom.flareScope: visible input image only; finite sensor crop, no offscreen-source/lens-tracing/occlusion inference
bloom.model: single threshold-free linear HDR PSF; opt-in affine ghost/veil share at most 1.8% radiance redistribution

hdr.limits: System-reported luminance is not a photometer measurement and scene lux is not calibrated. This is not an official ACES HDR ODT. Extended sRGB canvas is not a native 80-nit scRGB swap chain. External-image copy is not guaranteed zero-copy. PBO copies pixels through CPU. HDR enlargement is linear, not SDR FSR1.
hdr.shoulder: same fitted SDR ACES anchor through exposed peak 1; C1 bounded highlight extension; nit scale divided by browser/Windows SDR white

motion.attachment: RGBA16F: unjittered UV velocity.xy, previous linear depth, MSAA coverage; R16F: current linear depth; normalize both by coverage
limits: analytic rest-mesh wind and camera motion only; no arbitrary model-matrix animation
missing-coverage bridge retains conservative camera-only fallback
